Name: CyberGuard Read Only
Description: CG-047 read-only access for the CyberGuard Azure connector: resource inventory, network security configuration, flow log settings, Defender for Cloud, Azure Monitor diagnostic settings and Microsoft Sentinel incidents. No write, delete or data-plane action. Assign per subscription (CG-049: one subscription per assignment, preferably as a PIM-eligible assignment activated for the collection window); Entra sign-in and audit logs additionally need the Microsoft Graph permission AuditLog.Read.All (read only).
